name: [📌 UPD 4] BitSeas
desc:
👍 LIKE for a FREE x2 Training Boost!

  A One Piece life-sim you play entirely through the menus — no open world, just your story. Tap through a whole pirate's life six months at a time: born into a bloodline, eat a Devil Fruit, awaken Haki,
  master a fighting style, build a crew, and pass your legacy to an heir.

  - Menu-driven life-sim — age up event by event
  - Create-a-Character: look, era, upbringing & path
  - Be a Pirate, Marine, Bounty Hunter or Revolutionary
  - Canon Devil Fruits, Haki & turn-based duels
  - Family, crew & generational heirs
  - Climb to Warlord, Admiral, Yonko — or Pirate King
  - Daily rewards, codes & auto-save
